pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. A single weekly calendar strip with EXACTLY SEVEN equally sized rectangular DAY CELLS in ONE horizontal row, read left to right starting Monday. Each day cell has a small simple yellow sun pictogram at its top and otherwise blank. ONLY the SECOND cell from the LEFT is filled pale red with a strong red border, all other SIX cells white with gray borders. One red arrow points precisely downward to that SECOND cell. No other highlighted cell. This selected ordinal day communicates the specific weekday. No header, no day names, no dates, no lettering, no numerals, no other rows or cells. Calendar fully inside image with generous margins.  Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
